name: superdev-cli
description: Local-first product-building control system for humans and coding agents.
author: Rahul Retnan

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && node scripts/validate/validate-all.mjs && node scripts/package/build-ui.mjs check
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:tooling && npx release-it patch
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:tooling && npx release-it minor
scripts.release:major: npm run release:tooling && npx release-it major
scripts.release:dry: npm run release:tooling && npx release-it --dry-run; git checkout -- package.json package-lock.json 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.check: npm test && node scripts/validate/validate-all.mjs && node src/cli.mjs doctor && node scripts/check/release-criteria.mjs
